about.description:
graphed reduces a task graph to a concise set of stage nodes incrementally as the user
builds it, so a large un-reduced graph never exists. Reduction runs in a Rust extension
using equality saturation over e-graphs. The serializable IR - not cloudpickle - is the
canonical durable representation, so plans are reproducible and resumable.
about.summary: Schedulable, serializable, debuggable HEP task graphs with an interned Rust IR

tests.script: pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/frozen/core -k "not benchmark and not subquadratic and not reduces_fast"
abi3audit $SP_DIR/graphed/core/graphed_core.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/frozen/core -k "not benchmark and not subquadratic and not reduces_fast"

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.0.9"

package:
  name: graphed
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/g/graphed/graphed-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6996a2b524d88a60e095d9211b657f07f3dd4b7f6a6124ed8ce6b5a79fa310c9

build:
  number: 0
  # pyproject.toml pins `pyo3/abi3-py311`, so one limited-API build serves every CPython.
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
    content:
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - maturin >=1.9.4,<2
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then: python-abi3
    - pip
    - maturin >=1.9.4,<2
  run:
    - python
    - executing >=2.0
    - cloudpickle

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - graphed
        - graphed.core
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - package_contents:
      site_packages:
        - graphed/__init__.py
        - if: is_abi3
          then: graphed/core/graphed_core.${{ 'abi3.so' if unix else 'pyd' }}
          else: graphed/core/graphed_core.${{ '*.so' if unix else '*.pyd' }}
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      requirements:
        run:
          - abi3audit
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: abi3audit $SP_DIR/graphed/core/graphed_core.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          else: abi3audit %SP_DIR%\graphed\core\graphed_core.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/frozen/core/
        - conftest.py
        - pyproject.toml
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - hypothesis
    script:
      # the Rust IR suite; wall-clock scaling benchmarks are deselected as too noisy for CI
      - pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/frozen/core -k "not benchmark and not subquadratic and not reduces_fast"

about:
  summary: Schedulable, serializable, debuggable HEP task graphs with an interned Rust IR
  description: |
    graphed reduces a task graph to a concise set of stage nodes incrementally as the user
    builds it, so a large un-reduced graph never exists. Reduction runs in a Rust extension
    using equality saturation over e-graphs. The serializable IR - not cloudpickle - is the
    canonical durable representation, so plans are reproducible and resumable.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://github.com/graphed-org/graphed
  repository: https://github.com/graphed-org/graphed
  documentation: https://graphed.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lgray
